correctness.rationale: For a fixed finite comparison, existence of a backward walk longer than both structures defines cyclicity with two variables. Inductively counting noncyclic predecessors by child tree type recovers the attached tree labels. Distinct periodic forward sequences can be separated by a finite label prefix, and the exact counts of phases recover each long repetition weight. Loop and reciprocal pair tests separate short cycles; sum cyclic counts for their decorated necklace and divide by the tagged length, including the constant-letter two-cycle. Conversely, color the cyclic roots by phase and the noncyclic vertices by root phase and orbit in the corresponding rooted tree. For each color the counts of outgoing-only, incoming-only, mutual, equality and nonedge pairs by target color are fixed by the phase, tree and short/long tag, and the global class sizes match under equality of signatures. This is a balanced equitable coloring for the full atomic pair types, implying C^2 equivalence. Connected reconstruction follows and a nontrivial split of a long repetition weight needs at least two cycles of length at least three, yielding exactly the stated first collision. An independently written enumeration through six confirmed all counts and classified the collision. The phrase 'their sizes ... differ' in the Finding can only mean cycle lengths: the two graphs both have six vertices, as explicitly stated by the theorem.
residual_risks: The finite census corroborates the cutoff, not the unrestricted classification. The claim is within binary relational endofunctions, not a language with nested function terms.

evidence: Kiefer–Schweitzer–Selman supply related general results on relational color refinement and C^2 identification. Krebs–Verbitsky compare refinement and universal covers. broader_coverage.reasoning: These results can supply a broader method or overlap a restricted consequence. They do not provide the normal form needed to collapse whole repeated components and count primitive directed phases, with the atomic short-cycle exceptions. A reduction from the directed problem to the bracelet result is not established by merely forgetting orientation.

evidence: A general stable refinement test immediately makes the uncolored six-cycle and two three-cycles a plausible common logical class: each vertex has one distinct incoming-only and one outgoing-only neighbor. The exhaustive first-collision statement needs control of all possible decorations and weight redistributions. The directed proof recovers cyclic vertices and attached-tree types and proves the converse via phase-specific equitable colors.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The common equitability mechanism is prior, and the example alone adds little. The special combinatorics of total functions are required to give a complete explicit signature with short-cycle tags and quantitative weights; this is not a parameter substitution in the general criterion or a consequence of the unoriented classification without further work.

originality.rationale: The distinct contribution is the all-structures, phase-weighted normal form for directed total functional relations with separate treatment of loops and reciprocals. Neither the general refinement criterion nor the closely related undirected bracelet theorem supplies this statement. The census of isomorphism types and the six-point witness in isolation are not credited as new.
residual_risks: General literature searches were partly deferred; this is not negative evidence. An earlier directed automata, minimization or bisimulation specialization could have been missed.
The structural overlap with the same-day bracelet result is real, but there is no within-day priority inference and neither finding is credited with the other's domain.

value.rationale: The signature gives a usable complete invariant for arbitrary unions of functional components and identifies exactly which global information counting logic loses while retaining tree types, orientation and exceptional short cycles. It also proves the earliest failure of identification in this class without relying on the finite census as a substitute for structure. This value is not attributable to the already-tabulated isomorphism count or to the easy example alone.
residual_risks: No recovery of the number of long components from the invariant, and no identification claim outside the stated relational class.
